mapper.select: SELECT ec.id AS class_id, ec.name AS class_name, ec.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED')) AS planned_lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_lessons, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = ec.id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s JOIN attendance a ON a.schedule_id = s.id AND a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE') JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id = s.class_id AND cs.student_id = a.student_id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = ec.id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED')), 2) END AS attendance_rate, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a WHERE a.class_id = ec.id AND a.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED')) = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = ec.id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id = a.class_id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id = a.id AND sub.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE a.class_id = ec.id AND a.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED')) / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a WHERE a.class_id = ec.id AND a.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED')) * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = ec.id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED')), 2) END AS assignment_completion_rate, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(at.score), 2) FROM exam_attempt at JOIN exam e ON e.id = at.exam_id WHERE e.class_id = ec.id AND at.status = 'GRADED') AS average_score, (SELECT MAX(at.score) FROM exam_attempt at JOIN exam e ON e.id = at.exam_id WHERE e.class_id = ec.id AND at.status = 'GRADED') AS highest_score, (SELECT MIN(at.score) FROM exam_attempt at JOIN exam e ON e.id = at.exam_id WHERE e.class_id = ec.id AND at.status = 'GRADED') AS lowest_score, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_attempt at JOIN exam e ON e.id = at.exam_id WHERE e.class_id = ec.id AND at.status = 'GRADED') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_attempt at JOIN exam e ON e.id = at.exam_id WHERE e.class_id = ec.id AND at.status = 'GRADED' AND at.score >= 0.6 * (SELECT SUM(eq.score) FROM exam_question eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.id)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_attempt at JOIN exam e ON e.id = at.exam_id WHERE e.class_id = ec.id AND at.status = 'GRADED'), 2) END AS exam_pass_rate FROM edu_class ec WHERE ec.id = #{classId}

SELECT e.id AS exam_id, e.title, COUNT(a.id) AS graded_attempt_count, ROUND(AVG(a.score), 2) AS average_score, MAX(a.score) AS highest_score, MIN(a.score) AS lowest_score, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.score >= 0.6 * (SELECT SUM(eq.score) FROM exam_question eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id), 2) END AS pass_rate FROM exam e LEFT JOIN exam_attempt a ON a.exam_id = e.id AND a.status = 'GRADED' WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} GROUP BY e.id, e.title ORDER BY e.start_time DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS student_id, u.real_name AS student_name, e.id AS exam_id, e.title AS exam_title, a.score, a.submitted_at FROM exam_attempt a JOIN exam e ON e.id = a.exam_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.student_id WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} AND a.status = 'GRADED' ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 20
